title: UniMoE-CP: Unified Conditional Waveform Prediction Across Measured Optical Wireless Links
abstract: arXiv:2611.33198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shared prediction across measured optical wireless links requires a common model to accommodate link-dependent waveform dynamics. This paper studies unified learning for underwater optical, 100-m visible-light communication and 4.3-km free-space optical links. We formulate received-waveform forecasting from historical observations and known future transmitted excitation using one shared parameter set. UniMoE-CP combines a shared pool of temporal experts, window-dependent routing and spectral covariate fusion with an autoregressive decoder. The design permits conditional specialization while reusing expert parameters across the measured links. Pooled-training benchmarks evaluate each link separately and report an aggregated result using normalized mean square error (NMSE) and normalized mean absolute error (NMAE). translated_title: UniMoE-CP：跨实测光无线链路的统一条件波形预测
translated_abstract: 跨实测光无线链路的共享预测需要一个通用模型来适应链路相关的波形动态特性。本文研究了针对水下光通信、100米可见光通信（VLC）和4.3公里自由空间光（FSO）链路的统一学习。我们利用单一共享参数集，基于历史观测数据和已知的未来发射激励信号，对接收波形进行预测建模。UniMoE-CP将共享的时间专家池、依赖窗口的路由机制和光谱协变量融合与自回归解码器相结合。该设计在跨实测链路复用专家参数的同时，实现了条件化的专门化处理。混合训练基准测试分别评估每条链路，并使用归一化均方误差（NMSE）和归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE）报告聚合结果。报告的平均NMSE降低为：100米可见光通信29.9%、水下光通信29.1%、4.3公里自由空间光通信21.4%。
tldr: 该论文提出UniMoE-CP，一个结合共享时间专家池、窗口相关路由与光谱协变量融合的统一条件波形预测模型，可在水下光、100米可见光和4.3公里自由空间光等多种实测链路上实现共享参数的波形预测，并分别取得29.9%、29.1%和21.4%的平均NMSE降低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes UniMoE-CP, a unified conditional waveform prediction model combining a shared pool of temporal experts, window-dependent routing, and spectral covariate fusion, which achieves shared-parameter waveform forecasting across underwater, 100-m VLC, and 4.3-km FSO links with average NMSE reductions of 29.9%, 29.1%, and 21.4% respectively.
